candidate.derivedAnswer: A. Its square equals the product of the 2 numbers
candidate.answerReason: For positive numbers \(a,b\), their geometric mean is \(G=\sqrt{ab}\), hence \(G^2=ab\). This is choice A.

methods.label: Distinguishing geometric and arithmetic means
methods.explanation: \(G^2=ab\). The arithmetic mean is the one whose double equals the sum of the 2 outer terms.
